objective: Verify GitHub Actions run/job/artifact metadata directly against an explicit source-bound CI evidence request, reject stale/forged/unavailable evidence, and distinguish provider observations from offline claims.
nonGoals: No automatic CI invocation, rerun, workflow/ruleset changes or merge-queue entry
No interpreting candidate-controlled run logs as authenticated checkout provenance
No network requests in discovery, work-order inspection, or offline receipt validation
No claim that candidate-selected required jobs constitute baseline policy or independent acceptance
No artifact-byte download/provenance certification, deployment, release, or changes to other repositories
decisions: Provider API over HTTPS is sole source of CI provider-observed claims; offline snapshots are inspectable but unverified

obligations.description: Read only pinned GitHub REST endpoint forms; verify repository, run ID/attempt, workflow path/ID, event, candidate SHA and pull-request or merge-group boundary.

Require exact completed successful unique named jobs for run/attempt and reject absent/skipped/cancelled/failed entries, forged URLs, missing/expired/wrong-attempt artifacts, or incomplete pagination.
Offline/manual snapshots never become provider-verified or accepted; unavailable API remains unknown/blocked, and unchecked checkout identity is not falsely attested.
Expose explicit sf evidence verify entrypoint with stable result/exit codes, no implicit network or mutations; preserve existing SF-00 through SF-09 commands.
Document trust boundaries and verify exact changed scope without modifying GitHub workflow, policy, other packages or deployments.

structure: src/sf/ci_evidence.py: strict source-bound evidence request, GitHub REST reader and verifier
tests/test_ci_evidence.py: in-memory fake API and negative/provider-identity fixtures
impact: Adds provider-evidence verification only when explicitly invoked
Correctly separates pull request head, base and provider-observed run SHA from actual checkout/merge identity
No persistent evidence ledger; independently retained evidence depends on external record

budget.network: No network for development and tests; GitHub API only when explicitly requested with --source github.
budget.execution: Local focused tests and full suite on stable projection; open PR only after local qualification; avoid extra Actions runs.

externalEffects: Do not merge any PR until authorized PR #22 boundary
Do not enter merge queue, change repository rulesets or trigger workflow dispatch
Only opt-in read-only GitHub API evidence queries; no deployments or source-bot writes
